title: Unrestrained Simplex Denoising for Discrete Data. A Non-Markovian Approach Applied to Graph Generation
abstract: arXiv:2603.28572v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Denoising models such as Diffusion or Flow Matching have recently advanced generative modeling for discrete structures, yet most approaches operate directly in the discrete state space, leading to abrupt state changes. We introduce simplex denoising, a simple yet effective generative framework that operates on the probability simplex. The key idea is a non-Markovian noising scheme in which, for a given clean data point, noisy representations at different times are conditionally independent. While preserving the theoretical guarantees of denoising-based generative models, our method removes unnecessary constraints, thereby improving performance and simplifying the formulation. Empirically, \emph{unrestrained simplex denoising} surpasses strong discrete diffusion and flow-matching baselines across synthetic and real-world graph benchmarks. These results highlight the probability simplex as an effective framework for discrete generative

translated_title: 离散数据的无约束单纯形去噪：一种应用于图生成的非马尔可夫方法
translated_abstract: 扩散模型或流匹配等去噪模型近来推动了离散结构生成建模的发展，然而大多数方法直接在离散状态空间中操作，导致状态发生突变。我们提出了单纯形去噪，这是一种在概率单纯形上操作的简单而有效的生成框架。其核心思想是一种非马尔可夫的加噪方案，即对于给定的干净数据点，不同时间的噪声表示是条件独立的。在保留基于去噪的生成模型理论保证的同时，我们的方法移除了不必要的约束，从而提升了性能并简化了公式化。实验表明，无约束单纯形去噪在合成和真实世界的图基准测试中超越了强大的离散扩散和流匹配基线。这些结果凸显了概率单纯形作为离散生成有效框架的价值。
tldr: 提出了一种在概率单纯形上操作的非马尔可夫生成框架“无约束单纯形去噪”，通过使不同时间的噪声表示条件独立来移除不必要的约束，在图生成任务上超越了离散扩散和流匹配基线。
en_tdlr: We introduce unrestrained simplex denoising, a non-Markovian generative framework operating on the probability simplex where noisy representations at different times are conditionally independent, surpassing discrete diffusion and flow-matching baselines on graph generation benchmarks.
